name: Air Europa
verdict: Air Europa is 54% owned by the Hidalgo family through Globalia, with Turkish Airlines at 26% and IAG at 20% (January 2026).
note: Named as an Alverca shorts sponsor for 2026-27 only by Wikipedia's kit table, so it isn't on the kit record yet. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Turkish Airlines' 26% stake (agreed November 2025; awaiting the European Commission in June 2026, per ch-aviation) would put a state-controlled company over 5%: Türkiye Wealth Fund owns 49.12% of Turkish Airlines (turkish-airlines-state-ownership), about 12.8% of Air Europa along the chain, and Turkey's record is recorded (turkey-kavala-detention). IAG's 20% is a second path: Qatar Airways' stake in IAG isn't sourced here.
